notes: Needed: Combat gear to kill Sulphur Nagua (Perilous Moons) (level 98)

steps.text: Speak to Attala near the temple entrance at the southern base of Ralos' Rise to start the quest.
Climb the rocks to the north-east (requires 47 agility) or walk back up Ralos' Rise and kill the Sulphur Nagua at the south-east ledge.
Return to Attala. Cross the drawbridge and enter Cam Torum.
Go directly north and attempt to speak with Jessamine. A guard will interrupt you. Speak with Jessamine in the northern part of the city..
Pass through the entrance to the north into the Neypotzli dungeon.
Speak to Attala, Zuma, and Jessamine, in that order.
